objective: Test whether the 3-dimensional JOINT_LABEL / DIRECT_SUM boundary-association quotient is generated by two simple motif predicates x,y and their mixed product xy, all gated by the frontier-contact bit B.
source: Frozen RS085 SIGNED_PARITY|ZERO_VS_POSITIVE OOO triangle features and the REVAL-LEGO-BOUNDARY-002 DIRECT_SUM / JOINT_LABEL maps on the same 462 dependencies.

primitiveMotifFamily.symmetricFunctions: All nonconstant Boolean functions generated by the GF(2) basis e1,e2,e3 on the three edge relation bits, excluding the all-zero function and excluding addition of the constant 1 because B*1 already lies in DIRECT_SUM.
primitiveMotifFamily.realizationRule: Deduplicate primitive predicates by their truth vector on the frozen OOO triangle-feature catalog before pair enumeration.

pairSearch.pairs: Every unordered pair of distinct realized primitive predicates x,y.
pairSearch.dependencyAssembly: For each column, XOR its triangle-occurrence bit over each frozen OOO dependency residue.
pairSearch.criterion: After quotienting by the DIRECT_SUM row span, the three columns must have rank 3 and their span must equal the full JOINT_LABEL / DIRECT_SUM quotient.

procedure: Freeze and deduplicate all primitive motif truth vectors with no scalar access.
Freeze all unordered primitive pairs and their three gated columns.
Compute DIRECT_SUM rank, JOINT_LABEL rank and the target relative quotient independently from scalar codes.
Report every pair whose three gated columns span the full relative quotient, grouped by realized structural equivalence.
Only after the complete structural result is frozen may the known scalar code vector annotate which linear character of the three generated directions is value-bearing.
guards: This tests an algebraic shape, not literal H/V/D labels.
A passing pair does not prove its predicates are unique physical primitives.
Do not select candidate predicates from scalar behavior.
Basis representatives and x/y naming are coordinate choices; span equality is the invariant.
No geometry tags, state exceptions, sealed holdout access or RS096 continuation.
